title: Extended Exhale Breathing Exercise — 5 Minutes Guided (Longer Out Than In)
subtitle: Video · YouTube · Headphones recommended
blurb: Breathe in for 4 seconds, out for 8. The longer exhale activates the vagus nerve and tells your body it's safe to stand down.

subtitle: Video · YouTube · Headphones recommended
blurb: Four seconds in, hold, out, hold. Box breathing used by Navy SEALs and surgeons to perform under pressure.

title: 4-7-8 Breathing Exercise — 5 Minutes Guided (Inhale 4, Hold 7, Exhale 8)
subtitle: Video · YouTube · Headphones recommended
blurb: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7, exhale for 8. One of the fastest ways to activate the parasympathetic nervous system.
